candidates.name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Incline Shrug
Beginner
1
Leaning across the back section of the bench, with feet firmly on the floor and with arms hanging to the sides.
2
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Return to standing position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell in each hand, hinge at hips.
2
Pull kettlebells while flaring your elbows, squeezing shoulder blades. Keep back flat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
2
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
3
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
Beginner
1
Hinge at hips with back flat, holding kettlebell under shoulder.
2
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
3
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.
